newsitem.title: UK: LVMH outlines Guinness, GranMet holdings.
newsitem.headline: LVMH outlines Guinness, GranMet holdings.

text.p: LVMH Moet Hennessy Louis Vuitton SA said in an announcement to the stock exchange on Wednesday it had raised its holding in Grand Metropolitan to 11.05 percent from previous levels of 6.4 percent while reducing its stake in Guinness to 12.46 percent from 14.2 percent.
The two stocks saw frenetic turnover on Tuesday as the French company switched some of its holdings as part of its battle to block a proposed 24 billion pound merger between the two British firms.

LVMH chairman Bernard Arnault is pushing for the two companies instead to accept his own plans for a three-way merger and left the board of Guinness earlier this week, a decision which the board accepted because of his conflict of interest.
LVMH is the largest shareholder in both companies and now has a big enough holding to call extraordinary meetings of both.
LVMH could gain more firepower with its stake in GrandMet, analysts said, as the company needs a higher percentage of shareholders to vote in favour of the merger than does Guinness.
